rust_summary: native item component type registration (`native_component_types`) and opaque NBT component helpers.
doc_summary: `native_component_types(types)` runs once before content loads. Append namespaced component IDs; duplicates, invalid IDs and the `minecraft` namespace stop startup. `native_component`, `native_set_component` and `native_remove_component` read, set and remove registered components, including item defaults. Values use NBT and must fit the network reader limits. Bundles that use them need `"hooks": @API:component_types@`.
